summary.text: Robbie Mahrou, an independent who according to Ballotpedia works as a consultant, lost the November 3, 2026 election for New Hampshire's 2nd Congressional District to Maggie Goodlander.
Citizens Count describes his experience as loan officer, Hollywood producer and founder of a trading community called RoadHouse.

paragraphs.text: Robbie Mahrou graduated from Strake Jesuit College Preparatory and earned a bachelor's degree from Baylor University in 1999; Citizens Count lists the degree as a Bachelor of Business Administration.

Ballotpedia lists his career experience as consultant, and no prior elected office or earlier campaigns appear in the source. NHPR lists his residence as Walpole, New Hampshire, based on Secretary of State records.
He received 2.4% of the vote to Maggie Goodlander's 58.8%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
